functionality.reason: The normal import context/edit/detail path now works, but edited prose can be silently discarded by confirmation, model setup fails to persist its selection or resolve the import, and many current-code contract options and state transitions are absent or untested.

simplicity.reason: Import options are disclosed without hiding the context field. The populated library still exposes numerous parallel categories; native Sources repeats a large collector panel, explanatory blocks, and the connected-source list.

clarity.reason: Originals, records, indexing, and memory are named separately. File dispositions, model-required recovery, invitation scope, and obsolete deployment-draft wording still fail to communicate the actual state or next action.

design.reason: Restrained typography, spacing, and purple accents form a coherent interface; desktop task composition is readable. The narrow layout retains excessive vertical material and some repeated headings.

craft.reason: Main rendered pages produced no browser errors or horizontal overflow in the sampled viewports. The dirty-context confirmation and model-value reversion are substantial state-handling defects.

originality.reason: The calm archive-and-evidence presentation fits the product and has a distinct editorial tone, but many settings still use generic forms without a strong task-specific result.

findings.title: Confirmation silently discards the edited import explanation
findings.observed: Reproduced independently on all three platforms. After changing the review textarea, Confirm remains enabled and saves the earlier explanation. The revised vendor-ownership correction disappears from the saved detail.
findings.correction: Block confirmation while explanation is dirty, or require an explicit re-preview that uses the revised prose and retains the same task.

findings.title: Model-required recovery returns to an unresolved task
findings.observed: All three platforms preserve task identity and context, but the recovery screen edits the question model, reverts Local Processing on Save, and returns to Waiting for model configuration.
findings.correction: Identify the missing import module, persist the saved model assignment, and enable same-task continuation after the simulated readiness change.

findings.title: Per-file dispositions collapse into parsed records
findings.observed: The selected ZIP and both text inputs are all labeled parsed with one record each. No container, attachment, excluded, unsupported or separate-media outcome is demonstrated.
findings.correction: Use a meaningful mixed fixture with retained original paths, outcome reasons and counts; show failed audio/image stages independently from record publication.

findings.title: Device invitation inputs and lifecycle are missing
findings.observed: The source screen offers two example connection buttons. Clicking Android immediately creates a connected device. No reachable Central address, connection name, existing-device identity, one-use invitation, expiry or cancellation is presented.
findings.correction: Restore the contract invitation preparation and transfer lifecycle with an explicit device-collection versus account-login distinction.

findings.title: Current source semantics are absent behind several reachable entries
findings.observed: The source editor lacks ACK/version/conflict recovery; Android lacks native description ACK/conflict; A30 still describes obsolete draft-only deployment; account settings omit password/switch/expiry and the one-day session option. Directory reachability therefore overstates feature coverage.
findings.correction: Implement the current-source inputs, transitions and state-specific results without presenting generic save feedback as completeness.

findings.title: Import is simpler, but broader pages remain dense
findings.observed: The two-zone import is a clear improvement. The populated library still has a second long category rail, and native Sources repeats a large collection panel, explanatory copy, and connected-source list. Android places the source list below the first viewport.
findings.correction: Consolidate source status and actions into one list and keep uncommon library categories behind a named disclosure while preserving their task inputs.

findings.title: The ordinary context journey and collection boundary are improved
findings.observed: All three platforms retain exact multiline import prose through re-preview, saved detail and material. Fixed parser and archive-only image choice remain visible. Web folder management explicitly sends collection setup to Mac or Android; browser-selected folders remain a one-time upload.
findings.correction: Keep these improvements while fixing dirty confirmation and recovery. Include a role-specific synthetic preview so vendor/AI quotations can be checked as output rather than only explained in copy.

screen_inspection.major_pages: Library, Ask, Sources, Activity, settings and the feature directory inspected on each platform; note/import and native entry pages included. Every directory destination and visible disclosure captured.
screen_inspection.android_locator_correction: First survey matched hidden desktop navigation. Those four failures are evaluator harness errors, not product defects; populated Android captures supplied in evidence/android/major-populated, and empty major pages in journeys.
screen_inspection.scope: Navigation/disclosure survey does not award semantic completion. Stateful import and selected source/pairing controls are independently exercised.
